name: Sub page banner (web3)
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Sub page banner (web3).
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Content mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for content mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Accessible label

settings.label: Background image
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Background video (Shopify file)
settings.how: Select a video uploaded to Shopify Files. Supply a clear poster image where offered. Leave autoplay off for content that needs sound.

settings.label: Background video URL (MP4)
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Enable gradient overlay
settings.how: Turn on “Enable gradient overlay” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Gradient color A
settings.how: Choose a color for gradient color a. Check the paired background or text color: body text needs readable contrast, including hover and focus states.
